pieces.title: Sonic · Green Hill Zone

source.name: Sonic the Hedgehog · Green Hill Zone (Mega Drive, NTSC)
source.description: Masato Nakamura / Sega. Native VGM rip by DJ Squarewave. Original FM patches, PSG and DAC drums; verified against Game_Music_Emu at VGM sample timing.

notices: Native playback retains every FM/PSG/DAC command. The score display and cross-console ports infer notes from register activity.

Portable FM intervals preserve key-on/off and register frequency changes. Measured patch projections recover harmonic pitch and amplitude shape; factory timbres, stereo and release tails remain approximations.
DAC attacks use stream seek boundaries and repeated PCM prefixes; kick/snare families are inferred from waveform activity, not original game instrument labels.
